DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having any trouble in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベンチで読んでいた本を忘れました。あちこち探す前に、最後に座った場所を案内図で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れた本を無作為に探さず最後の読書場所を図で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left the book I was reading on a bench. Before searching all over, I want to check the map for where I last sat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to locate your last reading spot on the map rather than search randomly for the forgotten book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの入口から入り、どのように移動されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which entrance did you use, and where did you go from there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南の入口から入り、池の前で一度休み、その後は花壇の近くへ移りました。本を読んだのは花壇の方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 南入口から池を経て花壇で読んだ移動順を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I entered from the south, rested once by the pond, then moved near the flower bed. I read the book by the flower bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe entering from the south, passing the pond, then reading by the flower bed, in that order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図で花壇の位置を見ましょう。本の特徴は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's locate the flower bed on the map. Can you describe the book?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑の表紙で、赤いしおりを挟んでいます。池の方にも座りましたが、まず最後に読んだ花壇のベンチを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緑表紙赤しおりを伝え最後の花壇ベンチを先に探したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a green cover and a red bookmark inside. I also sat by the pond, but first I want to check the flower-bed bench where I last read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the green cover and red bookmark and say you want to check the last flower-bed bench first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見付からなければ、届いている物がないか管理窓口へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you cannot find it, ask the management office whether anything has been handed in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、緑の本を見付けても、表紙だけで自分の物と決めず、中に書いた自分の名前を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表紙だけで自分の本と決めず書いた名前も確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Even if I find a green book, I will not assume it is mine just from the cover; I will check my name written inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will check the written name rather than identify your book by the cover alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理窓口は入口側にあります。探した場所も伝えるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The management office is toward the entrance. Tell them where you have searched too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇のベンチを先に見て、なければ窓口へ行きます。表紙としおり、名前の記載と、探した位置を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花壇後なければ管理窓口へ特徴名前探した場所を伝えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the flower-bed bench first, then go to the office if it is not there. I will describe the cover, bookmark, name inside, and places searched.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that after checking the flower bed you will go to the office if needed and give the features, name, and searched locations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 花壇を案内図で確かめてからお進みください。見付からなければ窓口へどうぞ。お問い合わせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the flower bed on the map before you go. If you cannot find it, please come to the office. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 花束と大きなかばんを持っています。乗る時に花をつぶしたくないので、ここで持ち方を整えてから進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 花束と大かばんをつぶさず運ぶため乗車前の整理場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a bouquet and a large bag. I do not want to crush the flowers when boarding, so I want to arrange how to carry them here before moving on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to organize your belongings before boarding so you can carry the bouquet and large bag without crushing the flowers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの壁側で整理できます。花束に水が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can arrange them by this wall. Is there water in the bouquet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 底の包みに少し水があります。横にするとこぼれそうなので、かばんの上へ寝かせるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水入り包みを横にするとこぼれるので寝かせないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a little water in the wrapping at the bottom. It could spill if laid sideways, so I do not intend to lay it on top of my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not lay the wrapping sideways because it contains water that could spill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を空けて準備してください。車内の置場は乗務員や表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep the passage clear while getting ready. Check signs or ask train staff about where to put items aboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花束は立てたまま自分で持ちます。かばんの持ち手に引っ掛けると揺れるので、二つを別々に持てるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花は立てて持ちかばん持ち手へ引っ掛けず別々に持つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will hold the bouquet upright myself. Hooking it onto the bag handle would make it swing, so I will arrange to carry the two separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you will hold the flowers upright and carry them separately rather than hook them onto the bag handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご乗車までの時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have time before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一本見送っても間に合います。列車が来たからといって包みを開いたまま走らず、準備して次の便に乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一本見送れる余裕があり包みを開いたまま走らず次便を選ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can skip one train and still arrive on time. I will not run with the wrapping open just because a train arrives; I will get ready and take the next one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have time to skip one train and will take the next instead of running with the wrapping open. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車内では花束も他のお客様の通行を妨げないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: On board, please make sure the bouquet does not obstruct other passengers either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 包みを整え、立てて持ちます。かばんと一緒に通路へ広げず、置場に迷ったら乗務員に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包みを整え通路をふさがず置場は乗務員へ相談すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will secure the wrapping and hold it upright. I will not spread it and my bag across the aisle, and will ask train staff if unsure where to put them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will secure the wrapping, keep the passage clear, and consult train staff about placement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで準備してからお進みください。花束と足元にお気を付けて。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please get ready here before moving on. Take care of the bouquet and watch your step. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What can I help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域行事の準備を手伝いたいです。ただ、午後は仕事なので、午前だけ参加できる人も募集しているか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地域行事の午前限定手伝いが可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to help prepare a community event. However, I work in the afternoon, so I want to know whether you are also recruiting people who can join only in the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can help with a community event in the morning only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内に書かれた行事名を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the event name written on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この交流行事です。集合は九時、片付けは四時とあります。四時まで居られるという意味では申し込めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九時集合四時片付け案内だが全時間参加できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This community exchange event. It says to gather at nine and clean up at four. I cannot apply on the understanding that I can stay until four.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice says gathering at nine and cleanup at four, but you cannot participate the whole time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時間帯を限定した参加が可能か、担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the person responsible whether limited-time participation is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。九時から十一時半までなら参加できます。昼前に抜けるため、午後まで一人で受け持つ担当は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 九時から十一時半のみで午後まで続く独立担当は避けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I can participate from nine until eleven thirty. Since I leave before noon, I want to avoid a role I would have to handle alone through the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you can only join from nine to eleven thirty and want to avoid an independent role continuing into the afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: できる作業の希望も担当へお伝えできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also tell the organizer which tasks you would prefer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 机を拭くなど、その時間内で区切れる準備を希望します。途中で仕事を放り出さず、帰る前に担当へ終えた範囲を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時間内で区切れる机拭き等を希望し帰る前に作業範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would prefer preparation that can be completed within that period, such as wiping tables. I will not abandon work halfway; before leaving I will tell the person responsible how much I completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request preparation such as table wiping that can be finished in the available time, and say you will report the completed work before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加の可否は、担当の回答を聞いてから確定してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm participation only after hearing the organizer's answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午前の時間と作業希望を伝えます。受け付けてもらえると分かってから申し込み、全日参加の欄へ先に丸は付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 可否回答後申し込み全日参加を先に選ばないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give my morning availability and preferred tasks. I will apply once I know I can be accepted, and will not mark the all-day participation box beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will apply after receiving the answer and will not select all-day participation first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 午前限定の参加について担当へ確認します。ご協力のご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check with the organizer about morning-only participation. Thank you for offering to help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で測った数値の記録を診察で見てもらいたいです。何日か測っていないので、空欄が間違いではないと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家の測定記録に未測定空欄があり記入ミスではないと伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to show the doctor my measurements recorded at home. I did not measure on some days, so I want to explain that the blanks are not recording errors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your home measurement record has blanks for unmeasured days, not writing mistakes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付の書かれた記録でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、一週間分です。水曜と金曜は測っていません。前の日の数字をそのまま写して埋めることはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一週間の水金は未測定で前日数値を転記していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it covers one week. I did not measure on Wednesday or Friday. I have not filled the gaps by copying the previous day's figures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that Wednesday and Friday of the week were unmeasured and you did not copy the previous day's figures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点も診察担当へお伝えください。ほかに記録の見方で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the doctor that too. Is there anything else you want to clarify about reading the record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 土曜は二回測りました。二回目だけを選んで書いたのでなく、二つとも時刻と一緒に残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 土曜は二回測り双方の数値と時刻を残したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I measured twice on Saturday. Rather than choose to write only the second result, I kept both with their times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you measured twice on Saturday and kept both values and times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が数値と測った状況を確認します。ここで結果の判断は行いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The clinician will check the figures and measurement circumstances. We do not interpret results here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。空欄は未測定、二つある日は二回の記録だと説明します。良さそうな数字だけを渡すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空欄と二回記録を説明し良い数値だけ選ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will explain that blanks mean unmeasured and days with two entries mean two measurements. I do not intend to hand over only figures that look good.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the blanks and double entries, and say you will not select only favorable figures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録をお手元にお持ちになり、診察時にご提示ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep that record with you and show it during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原本をそのまま持って行きます。空欄を残した理由と二回測った時刻を伝え、見方は担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本と未測定理由時刻を担当へ見せ判断を聞くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the original as it is. I will explain why blanks remain and the times of the two measurements, and ask the clinician how to interpret it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will show the original, reasons for unmeasured blanks, and times to the clinician and ask how to interpret them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 測定済みと未測定を区別した記録ですね。診察で担当へお知らせください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: So your record distinguishes measured and unmeasured entries. Tell the clinician during your consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない訪問者に隣の人がいつ帰るか聞かれました。私は予定を知らないので答えませんでしたが、気になって相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣人帰宅時刻を知らない訪問者に聞かれ答えず相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unknown visitor asked when my neighbor would return. I did not know the schedule, so I did not give an answer, but it worried me and I came to ask about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an unknown visitor asked your neighbor's return time and you did not answer, so you want to consult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どこで声をかけられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and where did they speak to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の昼、家の前です。制服かどうかは分かりません。会社名は聞いていないので、配達員だったと決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼に家前で制服会社名は不明で配達員と判断していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Outside my home around midday today. I do not know whether they wore a uniform. I did not hear a company name, so I have not decided they were a delivery worker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it was outside your home at midday, the uniform and company name are unknown, and you have not concluded they were a delivery worker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手が言ったことを、覚えている範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell me what they said, as far as you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隣の人は何時に帰るか、と聞かれました。私からは知らないと答えました。中へ入れるよう頼まれたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰宅時刻を聞かれ知らないと答え入室依頼はなかったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They asked what time the neighbor returns. I answered that I did not know. They did not ask to be let inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that they asked the return time, you said you did not know, and there was no request to enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その後の様子は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you see what happened afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 角の方へ歩いた所まで見ました。その先は追っていないので、どの家に入ったかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 角へ歩く所まで見て追跡せず入った家は不明と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I saw them walk toward the corner. I did not follow farther, so I do not know which house they entered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you saw them walk toward the corner but did not follow and do not know which house they entered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた事実として伺います。今後、身の危険を感じる場合は、その状況に応じて連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will hear this as the facts you could confirm. If you feel personally in danger in future, contact the appropriate service for that situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻と聞かれた言葉、見た範囲を伝えます。隣人の帰宅予定を推測して相手へ知らせることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻発言目撃範囲を伝え隣人予定を推測で教えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give the time, words spoken, and what I saw. I will not guess my neighbor's return schedule and tell it to that person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will give the time, words, and scope of your observations without guessing and sharing your neighbor's schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訪問者の問いと見た経過を承りました。分かる範囲でのご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have heard the visitor's question and the events you saw. Thank you for consulting us within the limits of what you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お送りになる物について何かご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have a question about something you are sending?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ旅行の写真を送ります。袋の中で順が変わっても、撮った順番が分かるようにしてから包みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真が袋内で入替わっても撮影順が伝わるよう準備したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending travel photographs to my family. Before wrapping them, I want to make the shooting order clear even if they get rearranged inside the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to make the photographing order clear even if the pictures change places in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は何枚ありますか。既に番号などを書きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: How many photographs are there? Have you already written numbers or anything on them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六枚です。写真には直接書かず、一枚ずつ透明の袋へ入れて、その袋に番号を書こうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六枚の写真へ直接書かず個別の透明袋に番号を書く案を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Six. I plan to put each in its own clear sleeve and write a number on the sleeve rather than directly on the photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to number individual clear sleeves rather than write directly on the six photographs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは内容の順番は判断できませんが、準備した後に包装をご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine the order of the contents here, but you can ask about packaging after preparing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で日付と場所を確認します。袋の番号と同じ番号で別紙に説明を書けば、袋が入れ替わってもどの写真の説明か分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影日と場所を確かめ個別袋と説明別紙を同じ番号で対応させると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check the dates and locations myself. If I write explanations on a separate sheet using the same numbers as the sleeves, it will be clear which photo each explanation belongs to even if the sleeves move around.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you will check shooting dates and locations and match individual sleeves and a separate explanation sheet using the same numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を傷めない入れ方もご確認ください。今日このまま発送しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check that they are enclosed without damaging the photos. Will you send them as they are today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一度持ち帰ります。写真へ説明をのり付けせず、番号を書いた袋から写真が抜けないよう口を閉じて、六枚と説明の紙をまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は持帰り写真へ糊付けせず各袋の口を閉じ六枚と説明紙をまとめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take them home today. I will not glue explanations to the photographs; I will close each numbered sleeve so the photo cannot slip out, then put the six photographs and explanation sheet together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will take them home today, use no glue on the photos, close each sleeve, and gather six photos and the explanation sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備後に大きさと重さを確認して発送方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After you prepare them, we will check the size and weight and explain shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六つの袋の番号と別紙の説明を照合し、折れないように包んで持って来ます。受取人には袋を番号順に並べてから見るよう書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 六袋の番号と説明を照合し折れ防止包装と番号順閲覧メモを準備すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will match the six sleeves' numbers with the explanations on the separate sheet, wrap them against bending, and bring them in. I will write a note asking the recipient to arrange the sleeves in number order before viewing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will match six numbered sleeves to explanations, prepare bend-resistant wrapping, and write a note to view in numerical order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備してから包装と発送をご相談ください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please prepare them first, then ask us about packaging and shipping. Thank you for speaking to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通帳がいっぱいになって新しい物を受け取りました。古い方の記録も必要なので、二冊の期間を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 満ページで受取った新旧通帳の記録期間を整理したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My passbook filled up and I received a new one. I still need the old records, so I want to organize the periods covered by the two books.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to organize the recorded periods of the old and new passbooks after the old one filled up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い通帳はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the old passbook with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。古い方は先月まで、新しい方は今月からだと思います。ただ、境目の日付をまだ比べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧先月新今月と思うが境目日付は未比較と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I think the old one goes through last month and the new one starts this month. However, I have not compared the dates where they meet yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you think the old book ends last month and the new one starts this month, but have not compared the boundary dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記載された日付で確認してください。前の取引が新しい通帳へ全て写るとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the recorded dates. Earlier transactions do not necessarily all get copied into the new passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい冊子だけ持てば過去も全部見られると思っていました。古い方も残して、最後と最初の記録を比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去全記録が新へ写ると思っていたが旧も保存し境目を比べると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I could see all past transactions just by keeping the new book. I will keep the old one too and compare its last entry with the first new entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought all past records were transferred, but will keep the old book and compare the boundary entries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認したい取引の日付はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there a transaction date you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先月末の家賃です。新しい方にないから支払っていないとは判断せず、古い方から先に探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先月末家賃を新にないだけで未払いとせず旧から探すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The rent at the end of last month. I will not conclude it is unpaid just because it is absent from the new book; I will look in the old one first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will check last month's end-of-month rent in the old book instead of assuming nonpayment because it is absent from the new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明な記録がある場合は、担当へ日付と内容をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If any entry is unclear, tell the staff member the date and details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先月末を古い通帳で確認します。見付からなければ担当へ日付を伝え、新冊子だけを見て未払いと決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧で日付確認し不明なら担当へ相談して新のみで判断しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the end of last month in the old passbook. If I cannot find it, I will tell the staff the date, and will not decide it is unpaid based only on the new book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will check the date in the old book and consult staff if unclear, without judging from the new book alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二冊の期間を確認するご相談ですね。担当へお声がけください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You want to check the periods covered by both passbooks. Please speak to the staff member. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。商品について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この飲物の二本割引を見ました。違う味を一本ずつ選んだのですが、この組合せも対象か会計前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別味一本ずつが二本割引に含まれるか会計前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a two-bottle discount for this drink. I chose one of each of two different flavors, and want to check before paying whether this combination qualifies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before paying whether one bottle of each of two flavors qualifies for the two-bottle discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚の表示と、お持ちの商品を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the shelf sign and the products you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。片方は無糖、もう片方は果汁入りです。ボトルの形は同じなので、同じ対象だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無糖果汁入りで形が同じため対象共通と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. One is unsweetened, and the other contains fruit juice. Their bottle shapes are the same, so I thought they were both eligible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought unsweetened and juice-containing varieties were both eligible because their bottles have the same shape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示の対象商品を確認します。この売場では、印の付いた無糖の方だけが対象です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the eligible products on the sign. Here, only the marked unsweetened variety qualifies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 組合せで割引にならないと分かりました。果汁入りも飲みたいので、割引だけを理由に二本とも無糖へ替える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象は無糖のみと理解し割引だけで好みを替えないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Now I understand this combination does not get the discount. I also want the juice-containing one, so I do not have to replace both with unsweetened just for the discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you understand only unsweetened qualifies and will not change your preference just for a discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象外でも、その二本をお買いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you still buy these two even without qualifying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、一本ずつにします。二本割引の価格ではなく、それぞれの通常価格を足して予算を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別味各一本を買い通常価格合計で予算を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, one of each. I will check my budget by adding their regular prices, not the discounted two-bottle price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will buy one of each flavor and check your budget using the total regular price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通常価格は各棚の表示で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check each regular price on its shelf sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの価格を確認して会計します。レジで割引が出なくても、表示の読み違いだったと理解して申し出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各価格で会計し割引がなくても対象読違いと理解すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check both prices and pay. Even if no discount appears at the register, I will explain that I understand I misread which products qualified.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will pay at each regular price and understand any lack of discount as your misreading of eligibility. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象と通常価格をご確認ください。お選びの二本でお会計できます。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check eligibility and regular prices. You can pay for the two bottles you chose. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 木の絵を描いている間に影が動きました。追いかけて何度も場所を変えるより、この場所から続きを描きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 影が動いても追いかけず同じ場所から写生を続けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: While I was drawing a tree, the shadow moved. Rather than keep changing places to chase it, I want to continue drawing from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to keep sketching from the same spot rather than follow the moving shadow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いる所は通路ではありませんね。ほかに困っていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are not on the path where you are now, correct? Is anything else troubling you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通路の脇です。最初の影の線を全部消すか迷いましたが、時間で変わったことも残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路脇にいて最初の影線も時間変化として残したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am beside the path. I wondered whether to erase all the original shadow lines, but I want to leave a record of how it changed over time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are beside the path and want to preserve the first shadow lines as a record of changes over time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の紙で描くことはできます。地面や木へ印を付けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may draw on your own paper. Please do not mark the ground or trees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙の中だけで最初の線を薄く残します。木へ目印のテープを貼るのでなく、どの枝を描いているか紙にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙だけで線を残し木へテープを貼らず枝を紙にメモすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will leave the original lines faintly, only on paper. Instead of putting marker tape on the tree, I will note on the paper which branch I am drawing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you will preserve lines only on paper and note the branch there, without sticking tape to the tree. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物が通路へ出ないようにお願いします。もう少し描かれる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep your belongings out of the path. Are you planning to draw a little longer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あと二十分です。影を追って通路の反対へ椅子を移さず、今の位置から見える枝を仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: あと二十分同じ位置から見える枝を描き通路反対へ移らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Twenty more minutes. I will finish the branches visible from this spot rather than move my chair to the opposite side of the path to chase the shadow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will draw visible branches from the same spot for twenty more minutes without moving across the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お帰りの際は、道具や紙の切れ端もお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When leaving, please take your tools and scraps of paper home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二十分ほどここで続け、影が変わった時間を紙へ書きます。道具を数え、小さな紙も袋へ入れて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間を紙へ書き道具と切れ端も回収して帰ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will continue here for about twenty minutes and write on the paper when the shadow changed. I will count my tools and put even small pieces of paper in my bag before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will write the time on the paper and collect tools and scraps before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 周囲の通行に気を付けてお楽しみください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy your drawing while being mindful of people passing nearby. Thank you for speaking to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having a problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自販機で飲物を買いましたが、電話に出ている間に取り出すのを忘れました。戻った時は受取口が空だったので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自販機購入後電話中に取り忘れ戻ると受取口が空で相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought a drink from a vending machine but forgot to take it while answering a call. When I returned, the collection slot was empty, so I want to ask about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that after buying from a vending machine you forgot to collect the drink during a call, returned to an empty slot, and want to consult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの機械で、いつ購入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which machine was it, and when did you buy it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待合の入口側で、五分ほど前です。売店で買ったのではなく、硬貨を入れて水を選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口側機械五分前に硬貨で水購入し売店購入ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one by the waiting area's entrance, about five minutes ago. I did not buy from the shop; I inserted coins and selected water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you bought water with coins at the entrance-side machine five minutes ago, not from the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機械の管理連絡先を確認できます。取り出す前に商品が出た音などは聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the machine management contact. Before collecting it, did you hear the sound of the product dropping or anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 音は聞きましたが、受取口の中までは見ていません。誰かが持って行ったと決めず、見たことだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 排出音は聞いたが口は未確認で他人の持去りと断定しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I heard a sound, but did not look inside the collection slot. I will report only what I saw rather than conclude someone took it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you heard the dispensing sound but did not check the slot, and will not conclude another person took it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械番号と購入した品を控えて、表示の連絡先へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Note the machine number and product purchased, and ask at the displayed contact address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を控えます。列車が近いので、別の飲物を買うかは自分で決めますが、二本分返してほしいという相談ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械番号を控え追加購入と一回分問い合わせを分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will note the number. My train is soon, so I will decide myself whether to buy another drink, but I am not asking for a refund for two bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will note the machine number and distinguish an additional purchase from an inquiry about the one purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 問い合わせでは、一回の購入について説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When asking, please explain the single purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一回分の時刻、機械番号、水を選んだことを伝えます。受取口を離れたので中を見ていないことも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一回の時刻番号品名と口を離れ未確認だった経過を説明すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give the time of that purchase, machine number, and that I selected water. I will also explain that I left the slot and did not look inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will explain one purchase's time, number, product and how you left without checking inside the slot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 購入時の経過を分けてお問い合わせください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please distinguish the events at the time of purchase when making your inquiry. Thank you for speaking to us.
